study: Cross-Project Heterogeneity in Quality-Oriented Engineering Change
finding: Maintenance-intent composition differs materially across Apache projects. Restricting inference to the 43 projects with at least 20 manually labeled commits yields chi-square(84)=432.452, p≈2.46e-48 and Cramer's V=0.302. The effect is nearly unchanged for projects with at least 30 labels (V=0.300), indicating that the heterogeneity is not driven only by very small project samples.
source: Trautsch et al. SmartSHARK manual commit-intent labels, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.7078179
